method: Checked by a separate process from the one that wrote these articles — each was drafted by its own subagent, and this pass fetched the cited sources and ruled on the claims itself. It is independent in that sense and NOT exhaustive: it covers the load-bearing claims listed against each article and does not certify every figure in them. The exhaustive checkers scheduled for these five had not returned when the wave closed, and inventing their verdicts would have been worse than recording the narrower thing that actually happened.

Uncertainty in the absolute baseline global temperature is around 0.5 °C; in the annual anomaly closer to 0.06 °C

The 1750 unperturbed abundances used in the AGGI forcing expressions: CO2 278.3 ppm, CH4 729.2 ppb, N2O 270.1 ppb
Total 2024 radiative forcing from the long-lived greenhouse gases, 3.539 W m-2
1990 is the AGGI index year because it is the Kyoto Protocol baseline year

findings.note: The AGGI landing page rounds to 1.54; the article uses 1.538, which is the value in the machine-readable table the same page distributes and which this repository ingests. Both are the provider’s own figures at different precision, and the source line names the table.
